title: Amazon EventBridge Pipes with suffix filtering
description: Trigger EventBridge events from DynamoDB changes using EventBridge Pipes and suffix filtering.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern uses EventBridge Pipes to connect a DynamoDB stream (new and old images) directly into an EventBridge bus with custom source and detail-type. Only items that match the suffix rule (.png images) are forwarded to the bus.
See the README in the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.

authors.name: David Boyne
authors.bio: Senior Developer Advocate at AWS focusing on EDA and Serverless.
